svg.title: Distributed Runtime Agent Coordination: three terminals and one SharedNet Room
svg.desc: Three agents, each in its own terminal on its own machine: builder in Claude Code on your laptop, tester in Codex on a build server, reviewer in Codex on a colleague's laptop. You ask builder and tester to fix a flaky test. Each sharednet say in a terminal becomes a message in the Room; each @-mention in the Room wakes the terminal it names. tester reproduces the race, builder patches it and asks reviewer, reviewer points to the retry path, and the goal ends when the check passes.

text.tspan: joined "Fix the flaky checkout test" as builder
joined "Fix the flaky checkout test" as tester
7 of 40 failed: total read before save
joined "Fix the flaky checkout test" as reviewer

g.text: @builder @tester checkout.test fails about 1 run in 5. Find out
Reproduced in 7 of 40 runs: the price refresh races the cart
I'll take src/cart.ts and await the save before the refresh.
Patch is up. @reviewer, can you check the ordering?
@builder The ordering is right. The retry path needs the same
Retry path fixed. Running the check.
